name: Hambo & Polska
notes: Hambo & Polska style pack (Doc 04 template, solo-first — the polska step, the svikt spring, and rotation training are one dancer's work; the couple turn is the destination and arrives late 🤝). Scandinavia's great turning-dance family, told with its two-layer history straight: the POLSKA is the OLD layer — triple-time turning dances danced across Sweden and Norway since at least the 16th century, surviving as dozens of village-specific dialects (Bingsjöpolska, Bodapolska, springar kin in Norway) each with its own weight and lilt; the HAMBO is the YOUNG layer — a single codified form assembled around 1900 from the polska family for the national-romantic ballroom, now the standardized dance every Swedish folk-dance club teaches first. This pack teaches toward the living polska tradition through the hambo's clearer doorway, and says which layer is which. The body's secret is the SVIKT — the springy knee-dip that makes Scandinavian dancing look like walking on soft moss; the music's secret is the polska's ASYMMETRIC THREE (long-short-long in many dialects — beat two arrives early or light, and the trainer's pattern teaches the lean). The scene is genuinely welcoming: Sweden's summer STÄMMA festivals (Bingsjö above all) run all-night open dancing, folk-dance clubs worldwide teach beginners, and the European balfolk circuit dances polskas from Berlin to Lisbon.

seasons.finale: Film yourself stepping the polska three — the asymmetric lilt found, the lean understood.
Film the svikt spring through one full tune — knees breathing, head riding level, moss underfoot.
Film the hambo step-cycle solo — dal step, the turn's footwork, the rejoin — clean around your room.
Film continuous solo rotation training — smooth turning on the polska three without dizziness or drift.
Find a Scandinavian folk-dance club, a balfolk night, or a stämma — and dance your first hambo with a partner who knows the way.

attributes.name: Svikt knees L1
attributes.test: 90s of continuous springy knee-dips while walking, head riding level — the moss-walk, sustained with ease

attributes.name: Rotation stomach L2
attributes.test: 60s of smooth continuous turning (alternating directions each 8 bars) without dizziness, drift, or wobble — spotting optional, calm mandatory

nodes.name: The asymmetric three — the polska's lean
checkpoints: the polska's 3/4 is ASYMMETRIC in many dialects — long-short-long, the second beat arriving early or light — so the bar leans forward like a walker on a hill; the pattern is in this app's Rhythm Trainer
beats ONE and THREE are the dancer's ground: the svikt dips on them while beat two floats — feel the bar as down-float-down
dialects differ (Bingsjö's drive, Boda's float): listen to two regional polskas and mark where each puts its weight — same family, different mountains, the app's oldest lesson

nodes.name: The spelmän — fiddlers who ARE the tradition
checkpoints: polska music lives with the SPELMÄN — the fiddler tradition whose tunes carry village names and fiddler lineages (after-so-and-so titles are the credit system built into the music itself)
the dancer and fiddler share one svikt: good polska dancing looks like the bowing sounds — watch a spelmän's knee dip as they play and copy it
build a practice set of three: one Bingsjöpolska, one Bodapolska, one hambo tune — the doorway and two rooms beyond it

nodes.name: Old polska, young hambo — which layer is which
checkpoints: the POLSKA is the OLD layer: triple-time turning dances danced across Sweden and Norway since at least the 16th century, surviving as dozens of village dialects with their own weight and lilt
the HAMBO is the YOUNG layer: one codified form assembled around 1900 from the polska family for the national-romantic ballroom — the standardized doorway every Swedish folk-dance club teaches first
this pack walks through the hambo's clear doorway TOWARD the living polska tradition — and always says which layer you're standing in; ram wong's lesson, Nordic chapter

nodes.name: The stämma — the all-night meadow
checkpoints: Sweden's summer STÄMMA festivals — Bingsjö above all — are the tradition's beating heart: fiddlers in every farmyard, open dancing until the northern dawn, beginners absorbed by custom
the scene's etiquette is partner-rotation generosity: everyone dances with everyone, experienced dancers ask beginners as a duty of the culture — walk in willing and you will be taught
the balfolk circuit dances polskas across Europe year-round, and folk-dance clubs worldwide teach the hambo — the doorway is never far

nodes.name: The svikt — walking on moss
nodes.anchor: the spring the whole family shares
checkpoints: the SVIKT: a continuous springy knee-dip breathing through every step — down on the heavy beats, floating between — the thing that makes Scandinavian dancing look like walking on soft moss
the head rides level: the spring lives in the knees and ankles while the crown draws one calm line — the tea-cup standard, Nordic edition
walk whole tunes with the svikt before any step pattern: the spring is the dialect's accent, and accents are learned by immersion
mistakes: bobbing the whole body (the svikt is a knee event — a bouncing head reads as a pogo, not a polska)
square-three stepping (the lean is the music — a metronome-even svikt misses the dialect entirely)

nodes.name: The dal step & forward travel
checkpoints: the hambo's traveling step (the dal step): step-lift-step flowing forward on the three, svikt breathing under it — the promenade that opens every hambo
practice as a couple's ghost: travel a circle counterclockwise (the dance floor's traffic law) with your frame held as if a partner were there
the lift is a float, not a hop — beat two's lightness made visible

nodes.name: The turn footwork — solo rotation
checkpoints: the hambo turn's footwork, drilled solo: a full rotation every bar, the feet placing on ONE and THREE while the body turns smoothly through — the couple's orbit rehearsed as one planet
train rotation tolerance like the attribute demands: smooth continuous turning, alternating directions, calm stomach — dizziness is a trainable variable and this node trains it
the turn travels: rotation plus the counterclockwise drift around the room — orbit and revolution at once, exactly like the waltz pack's geometry
mistakes: muscling the spin (polska rotation is momentum managed by footwork, not torque — smooth beats fast)

nodes.name: Dialect steps — beyond the doorway
checkpoints: past the hambo's doorway, the polska dialects open: learn ONE village polska's step feel from Scandinavian source footage (Bingsjö and Boda are the best-documented doorways) and credit the dialect by name
the differences are in the svikt's depth and the bar's lean — subtle, regional, and the whole point: dialect is respect made audible
keep a dialect journal like the app's other packs keep credit logs: tune, region, where the weight fell

nodes.name: The couple turn
checkpoints: 🤝 the destination: two dancers sharing one rotation — the hambo's close turn, sviktande together, one orbit per bar around a common axis
the shared svikt IS the connection: couples who dip together turn effortlessly; the frame just reports what the knees agree on
learn it at a club or stämma — the tradition teaches the turn hand-to-hand, and your solo rotation training is exactly the preparation they hope a beginner brings

nodes.name: The meadow set — filmed
checkpoints: film one full tune: svikt breathing, dal step traveling the circle, solo rotation smooth through the middle section, one dialect's accent attempted and named
the moss audit: watch the head's line and the knees' spring separately — level crown, living knees, or re-film
say it on camera: polska the old family, hambo the 1900 doorway, and which dialect you borrowed — the layers, kept straight

nodes.name: The all-night floor
checkpoints: find the floor: Scandinavian folk-dance clubs and balfolk nights run worldwide, and Sweden's summer stämma season is a pilgrimage that genuinely welcomes beginners
ask for your first hambo the way the culture asks: anyone, warmly — being danced through your first turn by a stranger who svikts like moss is the tradition working as designed
afterward, teach one person the svikt walk — the spring travels in thirty seconds and carries the whole family with it

teachers.name: Bingsjö stämma — the meadow at the heart of it
